items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he created this theater in 1962, or something like that, and then he asked me to be part of the orchestra.

ctx.x: So, you were in the army until you were about 18 years old?

Yea. Before that, I was for two years in the Act de Musical in Havana, which is a fantastic group of theater, of Mexican theater created by the Mexican actor called Alfonso Arau. You remember that movie, Three Amigos? He was the one of the amigos. So he created this theater in 1962, or something like that, and then he asked me to be part of the orchestra. And it was there for me 13 years old, until I was 15. It gained the will of my father too because he wanted me to stay in the conservatory. I said, “Ok, I will…
While you were in the army, were you able to play music at all?
